title: Describing people and things: adjectives and state verbs

sections.title: Lesson notes
sections.content: We used adjectives to describe people and things, and state verbs for feelings, thoughts and possession.

sections.title: Grammar practice
sections.content: Use be + adjective for descriptions. State verbs such as know, like, need and believe usually do not use -ing for a present state.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: This jacket ___ comfortable.
Fill in the blank: We ___ a new plan.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.content: Practise words for appearance, feelings and everyday descriptions.

questions.prompt: Messy means not clean or organised.
Fill in the blank: I need to ___ the details before I decide.

choices: extra items you wear or use

sections.title: Reading
sections.content: Read descriptions and identify words that show appearance, feeling and opinion.

questions.prompt: An adjective gives more information about …

sections.title: Listening
sections.content: Listen for adjectives and state verbs in a short description.

questions.prompt: Listen first for the general description.

sections.title: Final review
sections.content: Mix descriptions, state verbs and useful vocabulary.
